made_by: Claude, by hand in a session (first issue, no API run)
intro: Two ships still to come this week: Silver Ray on Thursday and MSC Sinfonia on Friday, a turnaround day. Free shows across the neighbourhoods end on Sunday, and MotoGP weekend is next week, not this one.

items.title: Concerts under the dome, in the old town's churches
items.when: Until 26 Dec, several evenings a week
items.summary: A season of concerts inside the old town's churches. Tickets from €18.
items.port_day_note: Evening shows: for a port day, check the start time against all-aboard. Great the night before an embarkation day.

items.title: Free shows in the neighbourhoods: Cultura als Barris ends Sunday
items.summary: The city's free programme of theatre, music and street shows has its last days this week.
items.port_day_note: Free and outdoors in places: worth a look on a DIY port day if one is near your route.

items.title: IVAM: Melanie Smith and "Un mundo turbiamente vivo"
items.where: IVAM, Guillem de Castro, edge of the old town
items.summary: Two exhibitions at Valencia's modern art museum, a short walk from Torres de Serranos.
items.port_day_note: An hour fits easily between the old town and lunch.

items.title: New photography show at Bombas Gens: "Un destello de posibilidad"
items.where: Bombas Gens, Marxalenes (15 min walk from Torres de Serranos)
items.summary: Photographers from the José Luis Soler collection, in a restored 1930s factory.
items.port_day_note: Opened this week. A good add-on if your walk ends at Torres de Serranos.

items.title: Free concerts: Pepsi Invita
items.summary: A series of free concerts in the city, listed by the tourist board.
items.port_day_note: Check the venue and time: most music is in the evening, after all-aboard.

items.title: Free activities at the Mercado del Grao, near the port
items.where: Mercado del Grao, Plaça del Mercat Nou
items.summary: Music, storytelling and talks at the market by the beach and the port, free.
items.port_day_note: Close to the cruise terminal: an easy stop if you only have a few hours.

items.title: Valencia Basket vs Virtus Bologna
items.summary: EuroLeague basketball at Valencia's new arena.
items.port_day_note: Silver Ray sails at 18:00 the same day, so this one is for people staying in town.

items.title: Japan Weekend at Feria Valencia
items.summary: Manga, anime, video games and cosplay. Tickets are sold per day.
items.port_day_note: No ship in port this weekend; for visitors staying in the city.

items.title: Live music: Me First and the Gimme Gimmes, Macaco, Rock a Foc
items.where: Sala Rock City, Sala Moon, La Rambleta
items.summary: Three good nights of live music this week.
items.port_day_note: Evening shows, after all-aboard. For people embarking on MSC Sinfonia on Friday, Thursday night is free.

items.title: Heads-up: MotoGP is next weekend (27–29 Nov), not this one
items.summary: The last race of the season moved a week later this year. Some older listings still say 22 November.
items.port_day_note: Next week, hotels fill up and roads to Cheste get busy. This weekend is normal.

tips: Thursday: Silver Ray is in port 08:00–18:00. Your all-aboard will be earlier than 18:00: check it in your cruise line's app and work backwards.
Friday is a turnaround day for MSC Sinfonia (embarkation and disembarkation). The terminal and taxi rank are busier than usual: allow extra time.
Embarking on Friday evening? Drop your bags early and spend the day in the old town. The ship sails at 21:00.
Sunday: the Central Market is closed. No ships in port this weekend.
